name: pipp
description: Customer support, minus the fuss. Pipp is a simple shared email inbox for small teams, and with this plugin Grok Bot works in it with you: set Pipp up in a conversation, see what needs a reply, catch up on any customer conversation and draft replies your team can review. You connect your own Pipp account, choose what the Bot may do, and it sends a reply only when you tell it to.
